title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy expression for non-identical particles must be correctly stated.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy expression for identical spin-0 particles must be correctly stated.

title: Final Answer (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy expression for identical spin-1/2 particles must be correctly stated.

title: Perturbation Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the first-order perturbation correction must be correctly performed for each case.

title: Wave Function Symmetry
description: Important Criteria: The correct application of symmetry principles for the wave functions of identical particles must be demonstrated.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The setup of the integrals for calculating the energy corrections must be clearly shown.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expressions will result in a deduction.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the final energy expressions should be consistent and correctly stated.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Discussion of limiting cases or special scenarios should be included for full credit.
